data.request: teniendo en cuenta el plan realiza la lista de features del Agente B (catálogo). [Fase 0, cambio 11: AppRouter con todas las rutas, AuthGuard y GuestGuard, app.dart con tema, idioma y toast de sesión expirada, y main.dart con splash, orientación, edge-to-edge y reintentos.]

data.cmd: fvm dart run slang && fvm dart run build_runner build -d && fvm flutter analyze lib/router test/router && fvm flutter test test/router

data.summary: AuthGuard redirects guests to the welcome with redirectUntil(replace: true) and lets signed-in users through; GuestGuard aborts auth routes for signed-in users and replaces the stack with Home unless re-evaluating. Both take the session check and target route as parameters.

data.reason: The app test shows that redirectUntil(replace: true) at cold start leaves the login on the welcome: the guard must push on the first navigation and replace only while re-evaluating after a logout

data.summary: AppRouter with every plan route; App navigates on session start and end, opens from startingLink, shows the expired toast on its own overlay and follows system theme and language; main keeps the splash until the session is read.
findings: redirectUntil plus reevaluateListenable left an empty stack after login (the re-evaluated stack held only the auth shell), so the app listener owns session navigation and guards only refuse.
